correctness.rationale: The absorbing top state forces all n initial offsets 0,...,n−1 to appear among subset sums of the command multiset. A sorted-denomination gap argument bounds contiguous subset-sum coverage by S_k=sum_{j<k}min(m,2^j). Largest-first greedy commands based on increments d_i=min(m,1+previous sum) provably remove every residual offset in [0,S_k], so the upper and lower match for all n>=2,m>=1. Exhaustive BFS across 105 pairs independently confirms small instances; finite tests do not supply the infinite proof.
